name: Ngrok
description: Official Ngrok tunnel agent combined with an optional built-in Nginx Traefik filter (ghcr.io/murkbra/ngrok:3.39.13) in a single lightweight Alpine container — zero host config mounts, zero extra IPAM subnets, required static NGROK_URL, and local web inspector on port 4040.
short_desc: Ngrok tunnel agent with optional built-in Nginx Traefik filter
author: ngrok

form_fields.label: NGROK_AUTHTOKEN
form_fields.hint: Ngrok authentication token from your Ngrok dashboard.

form_fields.label: NGROK_URL
form_fields.hint: Static Ngrok domain or endpoint URL passed to --url (such as my-url.ngrok-free.dev).

form_fields.label: ENABLE_NGINX_FILTER
form_fields.hint: Enable the built-in optional Nginx filter (serves 404 on / and proxies all other paths to runtipi-reverse-proxy:80). Disable to tunnel directly to NGROK_TARGET without starting Nginx. Default: true.

form_fields.label: NGROK_TARGET
form_fields.hint: Direct upstream port or host:port (for example 80, 8080, or container:8080) used when the Nginx filter is disabled. Leave blank to default to 80.

form_fields.label: NGINX_CONF_BASE64
form_fields.hint: Optional custom Base64 or data:application/octet-stream;base64,... Nginx server block used when the Nginx filter is enabled. Leave blank to use the built-in default configuration.

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: ngrok (if left blank, falls back to ngrok).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').
